description: This file defines a class 'CohereRerankV2Config' that extends 'CohereRerankConfig'. It provides methods for constructing URLs, listing supported parameters, mapping parameters, and transforming rerank requests specifically for Cohere's reranking API version 2. The class acts as a configuration and utility helper for reranking operations within the project.

classes.name: CohereRerankV2Config
classes.description: A configuration class for Cohere's rerank API v2, providing URL construction, parameter support listing, parameter mapping, and request transformation functionalities.

methods.name: str get_complete_url( self, api_base: Optional[str], model: str, optional_params: Optional[dict] = None, )
methods.description: Constructs the complete API URL for reranking based on the provided base URL and model.

methods.name: list get_supported_cohere_rerank_params(self, model: str)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported parameters for Cohere rerank API.

methods.name: Dict map_cohere_rerank_params( self, non_default_params: Optional[dict], model: str, drop_params: bool, query: str, documents: List[Union[str, Dict[str, Any]]], custom_llm_provider: Optional[str] = None, top_n: Optional[int] = None, rank_fields: Optional[List[str]] = None, return_documents: Optional[bool] = True, max_chunks_per_doc: Optional[int] = None, max_tokens_per_doc: Optional[int] = None, )
methods.description: Maps provided parameters into a dictionary, essentially returning all supported parameters without modification.

methods.name: dict transform_rerank_request( self, model: str, optional_rerank_params: Dict, headers: dict, )
methods.description: Transforms given rerank parameters into a RerankRequest object and dumps it as a dictionary, ensuring required fields are present.
